- Action items I took away:

  2) Provide SOC 2 timeline and what we can share today.

  4) Outline our vulnerability scanning cadence and remediation SLAs.

Next steps: I can share the MAP now (attached). If you’re comfortable, please send over your vendor questionnaire (or I can kick off our standard questionnaire) and we’ll loop in Security to provide the pen-test summary and the vuln management details.

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-23T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Prod evaluation - security & next steps

Thanks for the flag — here’s what we can share and suggested language for Marissa to provide to FinHealth: 

1) SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II first full audit in 2025-11; current annual Type II engagement is in progress and expected to complete Q2 2027. We can provide the SOC 2 bridge letter and relevant security policy excerpts today; full Type II report can be shared under NDA or via a controlled access portal once available.

2) Pen test history & sharing: We perform an annual third-party penetration test (most recent full engagement: 2026-10). For sales purposes we can share a redacted executive summary and high-level remediation status without an NDA. The full report is sensitive and requires an NDA + access request. Attached is a redacted exec summary that is safe for sharing: pen_test_exec_summary_redacted.pdf.

3) Vulnerability management (scanning cadence):
   - Internal (authenticated) scans: weekly
   - External (unauthenticated) scans: monthly
   - Continuous SCA for dependencies; container image scanning on build and weekly recon of dependencies.

4) Remediation SLAs (typical internal targets):
   - Critical (exploitable RCE, data exfiltration): 48 hours triage/mitigation window, full remediation tracked within 7 days where feasible.
   - High: remediation within 7 calendar days.
   - Medium: remediation within 30 calendar days.
   - Low: addressed on regular sprint cadence.

5) Responsible disclosure: security@redwood.com (we monitor 24/7 and respond within 48 hours to acknowledge). We follow a coordinated disclosure process and will publish CVE details when assigned.

6) Evidence / attestations: we can provide bridge letters, policy excerpts, and the redacted pentest summary immediately. For anything beyond that we’ll request an executed NDA / DPA and create a gated share.

Suggested customer-facing language (feel free to copy):
"We have an annual third-party penetration test (last completed Oct 2026) and perform weekly internal + monthly external scanning. We can provide a redacted executive summary and remediation status immediately; full reports require an NDA. Our remediation SLAs target 48 hours for critical issues and 7 days for high severity items. For disclosure and researcher reports contact security@redwood.com."

Let me know if you want me to join the call with FinHealth or to review the vendor questionnaire once it’s received.

— Rishi Malhotra
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

Attachment: pen_test_exec_summary_redacted.pdf

- Pen test: We run an annual third-party pentest (last in Oct 2026). Attached is a redacted executive summary that’s safe to circulate internally (see pen_test_exec_summary_redacted.pdf). If you need the full report we can share it under an NDA — DocuSign NDA link: https://www.docusign.com/templates/nda-redwood-finhealth.

- Vulnerability management & SLAs: Weekly authenticated scans, monthly external scans. Typical remediation SLAs we follow are: Critical — 48 hours to triage/mitigate, target full remediation within 7 days; High — 7 days; Medium — 30 days. Responsible disclosure inbox: security@redwood.com.
